description: Close two verified silent-loss paths in roadmap regeneration. (1) An unbalanced `preserved-section` open marker is discarded on purpose (roadmap-preservers.js:233) so a typo'd close marker deletes exactly the content it was meant to protect. (2) readPhaseBlocks keys blocks by phase id in a Map (roadmap-preservers.js:268), so two `##` headings with the same text collapse to the last one and the earlier curated block is dropped — reachable via the second generation pass the CLI writes (bin/compose.js:1256). Guard by computing residue against the FINAL canonical bytes, not the first pass, using an occurrence-aware multiset keyed by line plus containing block. NOTE: the original justification (roadmap generate clobbers hand-authored prose generally) was DISPROVED — spliceTableIntoBlock preserves typed-phase prose and roadmap-roundtrip.test.js:83 asserts it. Providers bypass the CLI (local-provider.js:101, github-provider.js:524), so the guarantee is CLI-scoped unless it moves into the render paths. Anchor: docs/features/COMP-CONFLICT-MERGE/design.md
source: Semantica teardown 2026-08-08; re-grounded against code 2026-08-08 after design gate
